title: Grateful Dead Live at Musikhalle on 1972-04-29

ai_review.summary: Well‑mixed matrix recording delivers a soaring Dark Star that erupts into an explosive Sugar Magnolia and a monster Caution.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as a peak‑era '72 performance, with a fuzzy, space‑bending Dark Star that builds to intense heights before diving straight into a fiery Sugar Magnolia and a chugging, bass‑driven Caution. Reviewers praise the matrix source for its clear, very good sound despite minor imperfections, making the music highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (4‑5 stars) and enthusiastic comments highlight an exceptional performance; recording quality is good to very good, yielding a combined rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix mix is well done and clear; sound described as very good, better than expected with only minor imperfections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, exploratory Dark Star segues smoothly into a high‑energy Sugar Magnolia and then into a powerful Caution, maintaining momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers highlight Phil's bass work in Caution, describing it as a standout, driving force.
